cases.explain: The accusative case marks the direct object of a transitive verb.

cases.translation: He laid them down on the ground.
cases.explain: The preposition на (onto) indicating direction of movement takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он разместил войска в ___ дамасских арамеев.
cases.translation: He put garrisons in the kingdom of the Damascus Arameans.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Давид взял золотые щиты, которые принадлежали приближенным ___.
cases.translation: David took the gold shields that belonged to the servants of Hadadezer.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession or belonging.

cases.sentence: Царь Давид взял много бронзы из ___.
cases.translation: King David took much bronze from the cities.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Давид прославился после того, как перебил эдемитян в ___.
cases.translation: David earned a reputation when he struck down the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Joab was the commander of the army.
cases.explain: The nominative case is used for the predicate nominative after the verb быть.

cases.sentence: О боях вел рассказ ___ сын Саруи.
cases.translation: Joab, son of Zeruiah, told of the battles.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession or relationship (Joab = son of Zeruiah).

reading.ru: Некоторое время спустя Давид разбил филистимлян, покорил их и захватил Метегааму из рук филистимлян.
reading.question: What did David capture from the Philistines?
reading.explain: The text states that David defeated the Philistines and took Metheg-ammah from their hand.

reading.ru: Еще Давид разбил Моавитян. Он положил их на землю и отмерил их веревкой.
reading.question: How did David measure the Moabites?
reading.explain: The text says David measured the Moabites with a line when they lay on the ground.

reading.ru: Каждые две веревки были преданы смерти, а третьей была оставлена жизнь.
reading.question: What happened to the measured Moabites?
options: Every two lines were killed, one line was kept alive
reading.correct: Every two lines were killed, one line was kept alive
reading.explain: For every two measured lines of Moabites, David put to death one measured line, and kept one full line alive.

reading.ru: Давид взял золотые щиты, которые принадлежали приближенным Ададезера, и принес их в Иерусалим.
reading.question: What did David bring to Jerusalem?
options: The golden shields of Hadadezer's servants
reading.correct: The golden shields of Hadadezer's servants
reading.explain: The text explicitly states that David took the gold shields belonging to Hadadezer's servants and brought them to Jerusalem.

reading.ru: Давид прославился после того, как перебил восемнадцать тысяч эдемитян в Соляной долине.
reading.question: How many Edomites did David kill in the Valley of Salt?
reading.explain: The text states that David earned a reputation when he struck down eighteen thousand men of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

reading.ru: Давид правил всем Израилем, верша суд и правду для всего своего народа.
reading.question: What did David do for his people?
reading.explain: The text says David reigned over all Israel, executing justice and righteousness for all his people.
